title: Payment Webhook Timeout & Gateway Failover
summary: Step-by-step mitigation for handling dropped callbacks and latency spikes from external payment gateways.
steps: Switch API Gateway ingress route to secondary payment proxy with exponential retry.
Activate Redis idempotency queue to prevent duplicate transactions on delayed callbacks.
Notify Customer Support with affected transaction range and pre-approved customer notification draft.

title: Database Connection Pool Saturation Recovery
summary: Procedures for mitigating connection exhaustion caused by cascading long-running analytical queries.
steps: Terminate orphan read queries idle for more than 45 seconds.
Temporarily increase PgBouncer pool ceiling by 25% with memory headroom guard.

title: Major Service Degradation Client Communication Protocol
summary: Escalation paths and transparent messaging templates for merchant enterprise partners during downtime.
steps: Publish status banner to Merchant Dashboard status page within 3 minutes.
Dispatch proactive email to top-tier enterprise clients with incident tracking ID.
Provide CS agents with standard Q&A responses regarding transaction auto-reconciliation.
